about_the_game:
The official soundtrack of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die!

Lose yourself in the dark and whimsical world of Random with a soundtrack as unpredictable as the roll of a die. Orchestral melodies twist into heavy rock riffs, drifting between eerie ambience and bursts of chaotic energy - mirroring a realm where fate and chaos walk hand in hand.

Composed and performed by Ola Bäckström-Berg.
With contributions from Linda Bäckström-Berg.
